candidate_manifest.scope: Complete Attention and Brief public writer and existing final reviewer over the actual data-first candidate findings. No planner or investigation rerun, new acquisition or production writes.

review.critique_summary: The draft was clear and closely matched the evidence. I condensed financial line items in the Exxon and Regeneron stories to keep the prose focused on business implications, per the plain-English instruction not to transcribe line items. No material factual errors were found; several causal links correctly remain partial or unresolved.

personal_assessment.discovery: The candidate preserves the regulated-utility versus independent-power contrast found by its original data-first research.
personal_assessment.readability: Still repeats defensive contrasts, source-audit caveats and unexplained terminology such as rate-base growth, merchant prices, product cracks and beta. The model reviewer called it clear; my review does not accept it.
personal_assessment.coverage: Fewer stories is not itself a failure. Here the candidate omits important company developments covered by production, including Lilly and Rivian, and fails to explain the reported Binance breach. Its public supplied catalog includes only withdrawal-resumption headlines for Binance; breach reports exist in the separate frozen corpus but were not supplied to this candidate public reader. No new sources were added to disguise this gap.
personal_assessment.precision: The crypto headline says double-digit falls while its daily group figures are 8.8% and 8.7%, and it labels the withdrawal disruption maintenance without support from the resumption headline.
personal_assessment.figures: Useful figures and comparisons remain. The owner-accepted small example stands; contextual financial detail is not the reason for rejection.
personal_assessment.interpretation_limit: The metadata projection preserves all readable records and reduces prompt bulk and cost. This single replay does not establish why every quality difference occurred or restore the requested communication standard.

costs.scope: Both full editorial attempts, including rejected work; not a full-research run or production daily forecast.
